intro: Luxembourg is one of the richest countries in the world per person, thanks to finance, once built on steel.

chapters.title: From steel to finance
text: Steel once made Luxembourg rich, and the steel giant ArcelorMittal is based there. Today banking and investment funds dominate, and many international companies have European headquarters there.

chapters.title: Space and media
text: Luxembourg is home to SES, a major satellite operator, and passed one of the first laws on mining asteroids. RTL, a big European broadcaster, started there.

keyTerms.meaning: A pool of money from many people invested together.
